author: Eddie Van Halen
quote: If you want to be a rock star or just be famous, then run down the street naked, you'll make the news or something. But if you want music to be your livelihood, then play, play, play and play! And eventually you'll get to where you want to be.

author: Eddie Van Halen

author: Eddie Van Halen

author: Eddie Van Halen
quote: It's funny, when bands or younger musicians ask me: 'So, what does it take to make it?' Well, first explain to me what you mean by 'making it': Do you want to be a rock star or do you want music to be your livelihood?

author: Eddie Van Halen

author: Eddie Van Halen
quote: We're musicians. We make music for a living. It's that simple. Nothing else matters.

author: Eddie Van Halen
